title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21
lineage: Lineage: CD > Wavelab 6 > wav 16/44.1 > iZotope RX4 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > Flac 16
source: Sony F95's > Sony TC124 > Master Cassette - Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee

ai_review.summary: Remastered audience tape of the March 1970 late show delivers a solid early‑70s performance with standout versions of Casey Jones, Dancing in the Street, Cosmic Charlie and St. Stephen, while the cleaned‑up source still shows some pitch wobble.
ai_review.review: The three‑set concert is praised for its high‑energy jams – especially Casey Jones, Dancing in the Street, Katie Mae, Cosmic Charlie and a stellar St. Stephen sequence – though the third set loses momentum with a lackluster Midnight Hour. The recording is an audience capture (no soundboard) that has been patched and EQ’d; it sounds good overall but retains noticeable speed/pitch irregularities that require correction.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is consistently described as one of early‑70s best with many highlights; recording, while cleaned up, has pitch/speed issues but remains listenable. Weighted average (70% show, 30% recording) yields ~4.0 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No soundboard source; patched and EQ’d from Sony f95 tape. Pitch/speed wobble present (needs +1‑2% correction in several tracks), occasional patch at 7:31, but overall clarity is respectable for an audience capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set show with an early acoustic set, followed by two electric sets. The first and second sets maintain high energy; the third set starts strong (Cosmic Charlie, St. Stephen) but tapers off toward the end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for tight, crisp playing on Casey Jones and inventive riffs on Not Fade Away; noted to meander on single notes during Midnight Hour.
